core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ebrahim is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “An. The source record”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ebrahim corresponds to the Hebrew form إبراهيم (Hebrew אַבְרָהָם). Its core sense is father of many, father of multitudes. Variant romanization of إبراهيم (Abraham), a prophet named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'Father of Many' is a reasonable rendering.

arabic.long_meaning: Ebrahim (إبراهيم) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العبرية، ومعناه الأساسي أبو الأنبياء، أبو الجماهير. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
